payload.claim: `_print_stack_admission`'s docstring states that "every earlier candidate has already spent its own `budget_usd` plus one spec review by the time the next one's admission is checked," and the threshold arithmetic at lines 2278-2287 is built on that assumption. This diff makes the premise false whenever an earlier candidate is passed over for budget rather than run: that candidate spends nothing, so a later candidate's real admission threshold is lower than the printed one implies. The spec's own "Out of scope" section already names this and defers the fix, so it is a known, accepted gap rather than a hidden one, but it is a documented contract this diff makes untrue.
